title: SteeringFile
description: A steering file parsed from a markdown file with YAML frontmatter. Steering is injected into the agent context, either always-on, auto-triggered by a glob match, or manually referenced. See design.md §Data Models — Model 3.

id.description: Kebab-case steering identifier unique within its owning program.

inclusion.description: How this steering is loaded by the renderer. 'always' = always-on; 'auto' = activated when an open file matches 'match'; 'manual' = referenced by a skill or user.

match.description: Glob pattern required when inclusion is 'auto'; forbidden otherwise (the planner may still tolerate an unused value but the loader should reject).

priority.description: Load priority; higher values are loaded first by the renderer.

body.description: Markdown body of the steering content.
